scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api --workspace apps/mcp --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps/mcp && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint
